This is hymn number 208 titled "O Little Town of Bethlehem" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in F Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Lewis H. Redner and the lyrics were written by Phillips Brooks.
